source.note: Each photo is one side of a double-sided print: two schedule pages stacked top and bottom. Page numbers 3 and 4 are printed at the bottom right of Cluster III and Cluster IV respectively.
source.extraction: Text read from the photographs with the vision tool over overlapping column crops and label-anchored zooms; every cluster was read at least twice and the readings reconciled. No text was inferred.
